why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Do the one-time tasks: follow on X, join Discord, join Telegram.
Before 23 November 2026, 21:00 UTC, like, repost and comment on the 17 November announcement for the 200 points.
Give a wallet address. The form asks for "The wallet that will mint on Ethereum. Use one you control, not an exchange address." You type the address in; a new, empty wallet is the safer choice.
Go back to the hub. The whitelist task checks itself and can take up to a day to show the 1.1x multiplier. Do it before 25 November 2026, 21:00 UTC.
Check in each day and submit one X post a week if you want to keep adding points.
